verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's session docs state that each cloud session exposes a WebSocket endpoint for Playwright, Puppeteer, or any CDP-compatible tool. The docs landing page and introduction reinforce this by describing connecting existing automation scripts to cloud browsers controlled via Puppeteer or Playwright. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts connect unchanged, and no detail on compatibility edge cases or required code changes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my existing Playwright, Puppeteer, or CDP automation code to the product's browsers instead of rewriting it

citations.quote: Each session gives you a WebSocket endpoint to connect with Playwright, Puppeteer, or any CDP-compatible tool.
Connect your existing automation scripts to cloud browsers
Control Chrome browsers in the cloud using Puppeteer, Playwright, or our SDKs—no infrastructure management required.
